title: Retire and unpublish report a timeout for work that finished
description: Seen 2026-11-12 on Machines on Machines (Papyrus 5.105.0): both 'stories retire' projection runs and a re-run of 'ops content unpublish' returned 'Execution timed out' (AppSync timeout), yet the work finished in the background and the 301 redirects appeared within about a minute. The CLI reports a failure for a retire that succeeded. Fix: poll for the result (or the projection's completion marker) instead of reporting the timeout, and say 'still running' when it has not finished. Reported by the MoM story-development session.
